title: Consultor Power BI
description:
Como Consultor Power BI

Você será responsável por desenvolver, manter e otimizar dashboards e relatórios no Power BI, transformando necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados claras, confiáveis e acionáveis. Você atuará como ponte entre áreas técnicas e comerciais, garantindo a integração de dados de diferentes fontes e entregando insights estratégicos para a tomada de decisão.

Suas missões

  • Colaborar com stakeholders para entender necessidades de negócio e traduzi-las em user stories e especificações de relatórios.
  • Desenvolver e manter modelos de dados eficientes utilizando boas práticas de modelagem (esquema estrela, relações, normalização).
  • Criar métricas avançadas com DAX (ex.: CALCULATE(), FILTER(), ALL(), time intelligence).
  • Utilizar Power Query para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de múltiplas fontes (ERP, CRM, Excel, APIs, bancos de dados).
  • Projetar dashboards interativos e intuitivos, aplicando boas práticas de UX e design visual.
  • Integrar o Power BI com sistemas corporativos como SAP, Oracle e Salesforce.
  • Depurar modelos, relações e interações (filtros, segmentações, bookmarks).
  • Utilizar Tabular Editor e DAX Studio para otimização de desempenho.
  • Atuar como Product Owner de dados e IA, definindo escopo, prioridades e especificações técnicas.
  • Apresentar relatórios e insights a gestores e executivos com clareza e impacto.

Seu perfil

  • Experiência comprovada com Power BI em ambientes de análise de dados ou BI (nível pleno).
  • Domínio avançado em DAX, Power Query e modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência em integração de Power BI com sistemas corporativos (ERP, CRM, APIs).
  • Conhecimento em Power Platform e ecossistema Microsoft.
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).
  • Boa comunicação com públicos não técnicos.
  • Perfil analítico, atento a detalhes e qualidade de dados.
  • Disponibilidade para até 3 semanas de trabalho presencial (Rio de Janeiro).
  • Conhecimento básico em PowerCenter é diferencial.

O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente multicultural e internacional com oportunidades em projetos globais.
  • Programas contínuos de capacitação por meio da Amaris Academy.
  • Plano de carreira claro e personalizado (crescimento técnico ou gerencial).
  • Iniciativas de diversidade e inclusão, como o Coding Queendom, que apoia a participação de mulheres na tecnologia.
  • Cultura colaborativa, inovadora e orientada ao impacto.

Na Amaris Consulting, acreditamos que a diversidade é uma força. Valorizamos diferentes perspectivas e experiências, e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos possam prosperar.

Há uma jornada de sucesso que se desenha a mais de uma década de dedicação no mercado. A MCS Markup completou 11 anos de comprometimento e excelência, com mais de 350 talentosos profissionais espalhados pelo Brasil.

Na MCS Markup, o trabalho é mais do que cumprir tarefas; é uma jornada de crescimento e aprendizado constante. Se você deseja fazer parte de um time que valoriza seu desenvolvimento, que enxerga além dos números e busca impactar positivamente a vida das pessoas, então seu lugar é aqui.

Se você busca um espaço onde suas habilidades e potencial sejam reconhecidos, esta é a sua chance! Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que preza pela diversidade e pela igualdade.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos Consultor TAX , para atuar em nosso time na área tributária, no Rio de Janeiro e em São Paulo .

O Consultor TAX da MCS Markup atua na assessoria e consultoria a empresas em questões relacionadas à legislação tributária, buscando garantir a conformidade e eficiência nas operações fiscais. Esse profissional orienta os clientes sobre a melhor forma de cumprir suas obrigações fiscais, enquanto aproveita incentivos e benefícios disponíveis, além de minimizar riscos tributários.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação concluída em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Conhecimento no pacote office, com ênfase em Excel;
  • Vivência na área de Tributos Diretos com atuação em consultorias e/ou escritórios de contabilidade;
  • Inglês, Excel avançado e conhecimentos em ferramentas de programação/automação de atividades serão considerados um diferencial.

Principais Atividades

  • Cálculo e/ou revisão das apurações de IRPJ/CSLL (lucro real e presumido), PIS/COFINS;
  • Conhecimentos em benefícios fiscais;
  • Análise de contas contábeis, balancetes e demonstrações contábeis;
  • Preenchimento e revisão das obrigações acessórias (ECF, ECD, EFD-Contribuições, DCTF, Per/Dcomp);
  • Identificação e levantamento de créditos tributários;
  • Orientação e treinamento do trabalho de profissionais menos experientes;
  • Auxílio na interpretação das normas vigentes;
  • Elaboração de pareceres, relatórios e memorandos com dúvidas dos clientes;
  • Pesquisa e interpretação da legislação tributária e jurisprudência administrativa e judicial;
  • Coordenação e atuação em planejamento tributários e reorganização societária;
  • Participação em auditorias internas e externas;
  • Reuniões com os clientes para apresentação dos trabalhos.

Etapas do processo

Inscrição: Inicie sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro. Fique tranquilo(a), nossa equipe irá analisar as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.

Entrevista com Recursos Humanos: Você terá a oportunidade de dialogar com nosso time de Atração de Talentos; Seleção. O objetivo é nos conhecermos melhor e garantir que nossos valores e abordagens estejam alinhados com suas crenças e expectativas.

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta fase, mergulharemos no seu conhecimento técnico para avaliar as habilidades e competências essenciais para a posição.

Retorno do processo: Independentemente do resultado, iremos comunicá-lo a você e discutir os próximos passos.

Valores e Propósito: Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência. description:
MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, distribuídos entre emergência, unidades de terapia intensiva (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal, maternidade, clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos na Zona Oeste, região atendida pelo hospital, há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves em pacientes com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, com 39 leitos, que absorve demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII livre para casos de risco de morte, cirurgias urgentes e internações. Este CER possui atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prestar atendimento nas enfermarias, centro cirúrgico e Unidade de Terapia Intensiva do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Medicina.
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área.
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

O hospital está localizado em Santa Cruz - RJ. A carga horária varia entre 10h, 12h e 24h semanais, dependendo da vaga.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em diferentes modalidades contratuais, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma entidade civil sem fins lucrativos, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, atuando em vários níveis na gestão de serviços e organizações de saúde, com foco na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

A organização busca expandir suas ações na área social e educacional, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade social, econômica e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, instituições afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são geridas por profissionais altamente capacitados, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do SUS, garantindo acesso universal e de qualidade à saúde, apoiada por equipes multiprofissionais qualificadas.

O PAIS , iniciado em 2001 em São Paulo, estende-se a outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e a qualidade de vida, pautado nos princípios de integralidade e equidade, com gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM promove oportunidades de trabalho para pessoas com deficiência, com planos de carreira e anúncios periódicos divulgados nos principais jornais das regiões onde atua.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis de assistência para a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom


Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.


About the Role


We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.


Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.


This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.


A Day in the Life



  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.


  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.


  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages


  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.


  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.


  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.


  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.


  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.



Who You Are:


We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.



  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.


  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.


  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.


  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.


  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.


  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.



You should apply if this sounds like you:



  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.


  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.


  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.


  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.


  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.



Working at Darkroom


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.



  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.


  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.


  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.



Equal Opportunity Statement


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: MÉDICO PEDIATRA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, onde estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência, Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região atendida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial dos serviços oferecidos, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos e tem como objetivo absorver demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e internação. Um diferencial do CER é o atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

As atividades incluem realizar consultas no Pronto Atendimento Pediátrico, unificando dados de prontuários e prescrevendo medicamentos; visitar pacientes internados, avaliando sua recuperação; encaminhar pacientes para exames, tratamentos e cirurgias específicas quando necessário.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica ou especialização na área
  • Registro ativo no conselho da classe
  • RQE em Pediatria
  • Experiência em Pediatria

Carga horária: 12h semanais.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviços, com vínculo de grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou atuando em outra modalidade contratual, devem seguir as normativas de RH vigentes, consultando o setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de caráter filantrópico, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde via convênios e contratos de gestão.

A missão da instituição é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, focada no tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, fortalecendo vínculos com a comunidade e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com crescimento institucional, a SPDM expande suas áreas de atuação, incluindo projetos na assistência social e educação, consolidando sua posição como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

A SPDM contribui para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), garantindo universalidade e acesso à saúde, combinando tecnologia avançada com atendimento de alta qualidade por equipes multiprofissionais, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 em São Paulo, expandindo para outros municípios e estados. Seu objetivo é melhorar indicadores e a qualidade de vida, seguindo princípios de integralidade e equidade, com gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando publicações periódicas de anúncios em jornais principais de São Paulo e regiões atendidas.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com alta qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços de saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis da assistência para a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:
O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.

Inaugurada em 2012 a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais nas 24 horas do dia, todos os dias da semana, inclusive sábados, domingos e feriados.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

  • Realizar avaliação nutricional dos pacientes conforme indicação médica, prescrever dietas, de forma a promover à segurança, manutenção e recuperação da saúde;
  • Elaborar levantamento das prescrições dietéticas dos prontuários dos pacientes para elaborar o mapa de dietas;
  • Identificar as necessidades, promover e colaborar com planejamento, organização e atividades de ensino, treinamento no aperfeiçoamento do serviço;
  • Utilizar todos os recursos disponíveis de diagnóstico e tratamento nutricionais a seu alcance, em favor dos indivíduos e coletividade sob sua responsabilidade profissional;
  • Supervisionar a distribuição das dietas/produtos distribuídos aos pacientes que tenham indicação ao suporte nutricional;
  • Avaliar sinais clínicos, medidas antropométricas (peso, altura e IMC) e acompanhar os exames laboratoriais, conforme Manual de Nutrição Clínica;
  • Prescrever dietas enterais quando houver indicação médica;
  • Visitar diariamente os pacientes para inteirar-se da aceitação da refeição servida;
  • Documentar no prontuário dos pacientes a evolução dietética para que o médico possa acompanhar;
  • Informar aos médicos sobre os hábitos alimentares dos pacientes, disponibilidade, viabilidade da execução da dieta, entre outros;
  • Orientar de forma nutricional os pacientes em alta;
  • Estabelecer normas e rotinas para o serviço em acordo com a Coordenação do Setor;
  • Seguir rigorosamente as normas de vigilância sanitária;
  • Elaborar relatórios administrativos, estatísticos conforme necessidade;
  • Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho;
  • Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato;
  • Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes;
  • Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino.
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.
  • Possuir Ensino Superior Completo em Nutrição;
  • Possuir Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Possuir Pós graduação (Especialização) completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Nutrição em Materno Infantil ou Nutrição Clínica;
  • Possuir experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Nutricionista Clínica;
  • Possuir fácil acesso ao Centro do rio;

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Presales Solutions Architect
description:
3 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

We are a leading Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation studio with our eyes set on the future that crafts better futures for humanity by relying on cutting‑edge technology to create impressive digital products and solutions that widen your global reach. Our human‑centric approach guides us every step of the way and we’re proud of the impact our products make.

Are you someone who loves turning bold ideas into reality? Does the thought of experimenting with cutting‑edge tech and creating quick Proof of Concepts (POCs) excite you? At Arionkoder, our Innovation Team is searching for a Solutions Architect who thrives on pushing boundaries and sharing their journey through impactful communication. If you’re passionate about reshaping what’s possible with technology, we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement architecture: Design end‑to‑end technical architectures for engineering solutions that are modular, scalable, and easy to iterate on. Responsible across the innovation lifecycle from ideation, prototyping to deployment of technical architecture of AI solutions.
  • Define system components: Model layer, embedding logic, storage, orchestration, and observability, among others.

Security & DevOps

Review with security and DevOps team technical definitions inside the proposed architecture.

  • Lead technical discovery alongside our CTO, with the help of software developers.
  • Experiment and Build: Rapidly prototype and iterate on backend solutions, creating POCs to explore new ideas and validate use cases.
  • Collaborate Creatively: Partner with developers, ML engineers, and domain experts to design and deliver innovative solutions.
  • Integrate Thoughtfully: Integrate AI/ML models into backend systems, optimizing their performance for scalable, real‑world applications.
  • Support pre‑sales efforts by providing technical guidance and accurate estimations.
  • Optimize and Secure: Build scalable, secure systems using AWS services and adhere to industry best practices. Build core services and APIs using Python, LangChain, FastAPI, etc. Ensure clean, maintainable code and efficient ML/data pipeline integration.
  • Mentor and Lead: Guide team members, sharing your knowledge and fostering a culture of curiosity and experimentation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Highly seasoned solution architect with 5+ years of experience and familiarity with AI solutions architecture.
  • Curiosity and Passion: You’re eager to explore emerging backend technologies and stay ahead of the curve.
  • Experimental Mindset: You are comfortable testing, iterating, and learning from feedback in fast iteration cycles.
  • Hands‑On Problem‑Solver: You’re driven to create, prototype, and refine solutions quickly, learning from successes and failures alike.
  • Estimations
  • Great Communicator: You excel at making technical ideas accessible, inspiring your team and the broader organization.
  • Team‑Oriented Mindset: You succeed in multidisciplinary teams and believe innovation is strongest when perspectives combine.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • High proficiency in Python and backend development.
    • Enterprise Architecture mindset with a breadth of cross‑functional domains and technologies/skillset.
    • Sound knowledge in Architectural Patterns, best practices, security and Non‑Functional Requirements.
    • Strong experience with AWS and/or Cloud services.
    • Familiarity with integrating AI/ML models into backend systems.
    • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines.
    • Experience with security and safety standards in software engineering.
    • Knowledge of microservices using Kubernetes, Docker or similar tech.
    • Knowledge of Infrastructure‑as‑Code tools like Terraform or AWS CDK.

Extra Skills That Can Make You Stand Out

  • Familiarity with conversational AI, natural language processing (NLP), Computer Vision or ML‑based predictive models is nice to have.
  • Exposure to event‑driven architectures and message queues (e.g., SQS, SNS, Kafka).
  • Understanding of database optimization and performance tuning for both SQL and NoSQL databases.

Why Join Us?

At Arionkoder, innovation isn’t just a buzzword; it’s our way of working. As a Back‑End Developer on our Innovation Team, you’ll have the freedom to experiment with cutting‑edge technologies, build Proof of Concepts, and deliver impactful solutions that shape the future. From integrating advanced AI models to solving real‑world challenges, you’ll work at the forefront of technology in a team that values creativity, learning, and collaboration.

What Do We Offer

  • Competitive USD salary
  • 20 business days of vacation per year + 6 national holidays
  • Family Leave
  • A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from Anywhere!
  • An entrepreneurial environment.

About Us

In 2010 our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we are in permanent evolution and revolution that brings us closer to our goal.

At first, we did it through business consulting. Then, we shifted towards innovation and design. And now, we've decided to go the Arionkoder way: entrepreneurial vision and creativity are in our DNA, and this is the time to turn them into a tangible reality. That’s why we create amazing digital products with the power to impact lives.

We have been dreamers and we still are. We loved it and looked forward to the next revolution!

Seniority Level

Mid‑Senior level

Employment Type

Full‑time

Job Function

Construction, Software Development, and IT Services and IT Consulting

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. title: Software Developer
description:
Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developer calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT. You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test, and deliver high-quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross-functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements.
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team members in development/test technologies, tools, and processes.
  • Location: Tech Center - Ilha do Fundão - RJ

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related field.
  • Expertise in software engineering.
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software.
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby).
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such as K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka).
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS.
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI frameworks.
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design.
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite).
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services.
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms, and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI).
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators).
  • Knowledge of web technologies, such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, XML, JSON, and/or Ajax.
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards).
  • Exposure to developing in agile and iterative software development processes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

CHIEF ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER

Item Number: OSEC-DSWDB-CADOF-

Compensation: SG 24 (Php 98,185.00)

Place of Assignment: National Resource and Logistics Management Bureau

CSC-PRESCRIBED QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education: Master’s Degree or Certificate in Leadership and Management from the CSC

Training: Forty (40) hours of supervisory/management learning and development intervention

Experience: Four (4) years of supervisory/management experience

Eligibility: Career Service (Professional); Second Level Eligibility

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education: Master’s Degree preferably in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Management, Office/Business Administration, Public Administration, Community Development, Economics, Sociology, Human Resource Management and/or Accounting

Training: At least 48 hours of training on supervisory/management related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality assurance/control, volunteers’ deployment, human resource, procurement processes, planning, monitoring and evaluation, budget preparation, and capacity building

Experience: At least five (5) years’ experience on supervisory / management related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment. Must also have experience in disaster operations

Eligibility: Career Service (Professional); Second Level Eligibility

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Thorough understanding of RA 10121: Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act
  • Must have enough knowledge regarding government laws and processes
  • Above average knowledge on use of MS Office
  • Great attention to details
  • Above average knowledge in planning/organizing/accounting/monitoring and evaluation
  • Above average knowledge on the management of warehouse/logistics/production/donation facilitation/processing/monitoring/financial and quality control standard setting / institutionalization of volunteers’ assistance
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Able to work harmoniously, competently and effectively under pressure

JOB DESCRIPTION

Under direction and with substantial latitude for independent judgment, serves as the Division Chief and acts as the head of the Resource Management Division engaged in varied work ranging from routine to difficult and special work requiring training and moderate experiences or lower training but considerable experience and thorough knowledge pertaining to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.

FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Directs, supervises, coordinates the review of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, guidelines, systems and processes pertaining to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.
  2. Implements policies / mechanisms to ensure transparency and efficiency of procedures in the receipt, inventory, valuation, utilization and reporting of procured and donated items.
  3. Recommends and supervises personnel that shall be assigned to assist in the donation facilitation in the “one‑stop‑shop” to be established by the government in times of disasters/calamities.
  4. Supervises the receipt, warehousing, processing, production/packing/repacking and releasing of procured and donated goods as allocated by the Disaster Response Management Bureau.
  5. Supervises the deployment of volunteers during the production/repacking of relief items in NROC and other production /repacking hubs that may be established/identified as extension of NROC during disaster relief operations.
  6. Coordinates the establishment of institutional partnership with other government agencies, non‑government organizations, private entities, people’s organizations, etc., for logistical support in the transport of FFPs to FOs / disaster‑affected areas / designated delivery sites consistent with the relief allocation plan and volunteer assistance during disaster operations at NROC.
  7. Monitors the compliance of DSWD Disaster Response Centers and Field Office on the required number and type of relief items for stockpiling and prepositioning at any given time.
  8. Submits reports and documentation pertaining to inventory management and recommends appropriate actions, policy improvement and submits recommendations necessary.
  9. Supervises the implementation of the relief allocation plan submitted by Disaster Response Management Group in a timely manner.
  10. Supervises the integration/consolidation of programs, activities and projects of NRLMB in the Work and Financial Plan which include targets, schedules and performance metrics.
  11. Submits outputs of subordinates against performance standards and provides inputs to the Head of NRLMB in rating the performance of subordinates and in identifying performance gaps and proposed staff development interventions.
  12. Resolves staff concerns and raises issues to the Head of NRLMB when beyond authority.
  13. Updates the Head of NRLMB on the status of its deliverables/tasks regularly.
  14. Provides supervisory and consultative assistance/services to the Head of NRLMB, partner/stakeholders and FOs and DRCs counterpart to address the challenges encountered on logistics and production in the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.
  15. Attends meetings, conferences and other activities on behalf of the Head of NRLMB as delegated.
  16. Acts as resource person during seminars/training/workshops related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment, as requested.
  17. Assures functions as the Head of NRLMB if the Head is on official travel/business or on leave of absence or other analogous circumstances resulting in inability to perform the duties of the position.
  18. Performs other tasks as may be required by the Head of NRLMB.

JOB OUTPUTS

  1. Enhanced policies, guidelines and procedures relative to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.
  2. Memorandum of Agreement with GOs, NGOs, POs, PAs, etc., relative to logistics and production during disaster operations.
  3. Proposed Operations and Contingency Plan.
  4. Consolidated Operations Reports (quarterly, semesterly and annually) of NRLMB.
  5. Updates, Memoranda and other office communications.
  6. Technical assistance to DRCs, FOs, LGUs, intermediaries and stakeholders.

CRITERIA FOR EVALUATION

Education: 25%

Training: 10%

Experience: 25%

IQT: 10%

Technical Exam: 15%

Interview: 10%

Performance Review: 5%

Total: 100%

INITIAL SHORTLISTING

Obtain 80% of the maximum total score or 48 points in Education, Training, and Experience (ETE).

FINAL SHORTLISTING

Top five (5) highest rating but overall rating should not be less than 85%.

APPLY NOW

  1. Application Letter stating the desired position, item number/code, and office/bureau/service/unit addressed to Director Jennifer M. Rizo, Director IV of Human Resource Management and Development Service; Please note that wrong or lacking information thereof shall render the application void.

  6. Copy of Special Order or Certification indicating the supervisory/management experience/functions signed by the HRMO or any authorized representative (for Division Chief positions only or as may applicable).
  7. Copies of Appropriate Eligibility:
    • For RA 1080 Eligible (RSWs and/or other board passers only): photocopy of RA1080 rating / Verified Eligibility.

  8. Performance Rating in the last rating period or its equivalent, as may be applicable.

Buy Box Experts (BBE) is a Spreetail Agency, our mission at BBE is to be premier Amazon strategists by successfully evolving and adapting to the ever‑changing environment that is Amazon and e‑commerce. Our strategic growth mindset and holistic approach encourage forward‑thinking and provide the greatest potential for success for our Brand Partners.

We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with 2–3 years of experience in e‑commerce marketing and creative strategy to develop compelling brand narratives, drive conversion‑focused projects, and collaborate with cross‑functional teams. The ideal candidate has strong writing and communication skills, can distill complex information into clear messaging, and understands design principles and industry trends.

How you will achieve success:

  • Develop strategic narratives, experience design, and technical storytelling to shape brand messaging.
  • Research, conceptualize, and execute creative ideas that align with client and industry visions.
  • Translate audience insights into actionable strategies, marketing initiatives, and engagement tactics.
  • Conduct industry and competitor research to identify trends, opportunities, and challenges.
  • Collaborate with teams to create compelling narratives, immersive experiences, and data‑driven strategies.

What experiences will help you in this role:

  • Please make sure to submit your resume/CVs in English.

Required:

  • 2–3 years of experience in e‑commerce marketing and creative strategy.
  • Strong project management, writing, and communication skills.
  • Ability to distill complex information and conduct qualitative analysis.
  • Experience with design principles, cross‑functional collaboration, and third‑party partnerships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Amazon Seller/Vendor Central and Adobe Creative Suite.

$7.50 - $7.50 an hour

We consider candidates who meet the specific job qualifications, whether they are located near our Lehi, UT office or have the ability to work remotely.

Please visit comparably.com/companies/buy-box-experts to learn more about us.

ABOUT BUY BOX EXPERTS

Buy Box Experts, a Spreetail Agency, is a premier Amazon marketing agency, supporting brand executives as they seek to CONTROL and GROW their Amazon channel businesses (in the US and internationally).

We help our brand clients develop channel management strategies that reduce price erosion issues, and align marketing efforts with the brand’s overall brand vision. We provide full platform account management (1P retail, 3P marketplace and hybrid) incorporating inventory management, listing optimization, advertising campaign management (including AMS, DSP), and customer service. We also operate traffic‐building campaigns external to Amazon, designed to drive high‑converting traffic to Amazon. We conduct Amazon channel due diligence for private equity and investors looking to acquire brands that depend heavily on Amazon as a sales channel.

Our leadership team is very focused on building a company culture focused on being inclusive, encouraging open discussion of issues, and developing the team through a growth‑based mindset. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems
description:
Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems

Join Launch Potato to own the recommendation engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

Must Have

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Experience deploying ML systems serving 100M+ predictions daily
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices

Your Role

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

Outcomes

  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability

Competencies

  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as the main programming language (We will teach you Clojure). Main responsibilities:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS
  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture
  • Set technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies
  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies
  • Mentor engineers across teams, establishing and maintaining a high technical bar organization-wide
  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences
  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services
  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations
  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD
  • Good communication skills to prevent risks and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Advanced English skills
  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Plan
  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program
  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses
  • Extended Parental Leave
  • Daycare Allowance
  • Parental Consultancy
  • Work-from-home Allowance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Our primary language in the Backend is Clojure and it's not a required skill (we won't evaluate your knowledge about it in our process). Still, it's important to be open to learning it. Do you have any interesting cases or experiences using functional paradigm that you'd like to share? :)

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II. A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia‑geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos e dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves a quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. This is a global remote opportunity. This role is focused on creative optimization—crafting, testing, and refining images and content to maximize performance. Key Responsibilities

  • Improve CTR & CVR: Lead ongoing optimization efforts for Amazon listings through creative testing and design updates.
  • Main Image Design: Create and refine high-performing main images using poll feedback (via Intellivy or ProductPinion).

  • A+ Content Design: Design engaging, informative, and on-brand A+ content to improve conversion rates and customer understanding.
  • Ad & Storefront Support: Collaborate on Sponsored Brand creatives, DSP assets, and storefront design to ensure brand alignment.

  • Creative Testing: Collaborate with team members to plan, analyze, and implement test outcomes into new creative iterations.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven design experience, ideally within Amazon or eCommerce environments.

Join to apply for the Senior Research Analyst role at Wood Mackenzie

Wood Mackenzie is the global data and analytics business for the renewables, energy, and natural resources industries. In an ever‑changing world, companies and governments need reliable and actionable insight to lead the transition to a sustainable future. Our team of over 2,400 experts, operating across 30 global locations, enables customers’ decisions through real‑time analytics, consultancy, events and thought leadership.

Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Department

Research

Reports to

Senior Research Manager

About The Role

Wood Mackenzie is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Senior Research Analyst to join our Upstream team. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to our industry‑leading research and insights into the global upstream oil and gas sector, helping clients navigate the evolving energy landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver high‑quality research and analysis on upstream assets, companies, and market trends.
  • Maintain and enhance asset‑level valuations and emissions profiles using proprietary models.
  • Interpret complex datasets to identify strategic opportunities and risks.

  • Collaborate with global teams to ensure consistency and accuracy in research outputs.
  • Produce thought leadership content including reports, presentations, and client briefings.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Geoscience, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in upstream oil and gas research, consulting, or industry roles.
  • Strong understanding of upstream operations, asset economics, and fiscal regimes.
  • Experience with valuation models and emissions analysis is highly desirable.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to engage with senior stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Python).

What We Offer

  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment with global exposure.
  • Opportunities to shape industry thinking and influence strategic decisions.
  • Continuous learning and development through mentoring, training, and cross‑functional projects.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with your experience and impact.

Equal Opportunities

Tipo de contrato Contrato Duração Indeterminada (CDI)

Context & Environment

O Brasil é um país altamente regulado, com exigências rigorosas de SSMS e necessidade de demonstração de gestão de riscos às autoridades como pré-requisito obrigatório para qualquer operação. A TotalEnergies EP Brasil é uma afilial estratégica para o Grupo, em fase de crescimento (200 mil bpd em participação do Grupo até 2025). A excelência na gestão de riscos operacionais contribui para a expansão do portfólio operado e para o aumento da influência sobre os parceiros responsáveis por ativos estratégicos operados por terceiros (OBOs). A excelência em SSMS, Segurança e Integridade garante a sustentabilidade da reputação da TotalEnergies no Brasil, ao mesmo tempo em que preserva a vida de todos os envolvidos.

Atividades

Realizar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios do OneMAESTRO, visando preservar o meio ambiente e os recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e descarbonização dos ativos da empresa.

  • Participar de estudos de perigos e avaliações de riscos para garantir a execução segura dos programas operacionais.
  • Aconselhar e aprimorar o reconhecimento de perigos e o controle de riscos nas mudanças de gestão.
  • Participar diretamente na implementação dos Programas de Segurança da TotalEnergies EP Brasil.
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões de planejamento e coordenação das atividades diárias, reuniões semanais e de pré-turno “toolbox”.
  • Promover e incentivar o conceito de “Visita de Campo Gerencia em Conjunto” (Management Joint Safety Tour/Boots on the Ground).

  • Dar assistência, aconselhar e aprimorar as análises de causa raiz de incidentes e incidentes com Alto Potencial.
  • Participar ativamente da elaboração das “Análises de Segurança das Atividades” dos contratados relacionadas à execução das atividades.
  • Garantir a participação ativa na organização de reuniões de segurança pré-trabalho, com atenção especial para:
    1. preparação de operações de içamento,
    2. prevenção de queda de objetos,
    3. prevenção de lesões nas mãos,
    4. operações simultâneas e
    5. operações críticas.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar para garantir os prazos e acuidade dos relatórios de eventos, incidentes, acidentes e anomalias.
  • Garantir o monitoramento da performance de HSE e benchmarking relacionados os KPIs atualizados, conhecidos e acompanhados.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar no aprimoramento da competência e treinamento das equipes em HSE (empresa e contratados).
  • Garantir os prazos e acuidade ao reportar os eventos de HSE no sistema OneSynergi.
  • Fornecer treinamentos específicos de HSE no campo, conforme necessário, garantindo a inclusão de toda a supervisão dos contratados.
  • Verificar a aplicação da política de HSE e dos documentos de referência relacionados, incluindo os procedimentos da TotalEnergies EP Brasil e as Regras de HSE do Grupo TotalEnergies.
  • Desenvolver Documentos de Integração com Contratados (Bridging Documents) e garantir que sejam compreendidos, relevantes e utilizados nas atividades de execução dos programas.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar o Gerente de Operações HSE.
  • Auxiliar, aconselhar e aprimorar os meios de identificação de perigos e controle de riscos em operações simultâneas (SIMOPS) e/ou situações degradadas.
  • Dar suporte no gerenciamento e na comunicação de forma eficaz ao pessoal de campo sobre ações corretivas relacionadas a acidentes, inspeções, auditorias e revisões.
  • Realizar auditorias e inspeções para garantir o devido alinhamento com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE da TotalEnergies e com o OneMAESTRO.

Responsabilidades

  • Aconselhar e auxiliar o Gerente de Operações HSE na aplicação da política de HSE e na execução eficaz dos programas de trabalho definidos.

Perfil do Candidato

title: Junior Analyst/Analyst, Economics
description:
About CPI

Climate Policy Initiative (CPI) is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change. CPI has seven offices around the world in Brazil, India, Indonesia, Kenya, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

In Brazil, CPI has a partnership with PUC-Rio. CPI/PUC-Rio supports public policies in Brazil through evidence-based research and strategic partnerships with members of the government and civil society.

Position Summary

Under the supervision of a Senior Analyst and guidance of the Program Director, the Junior Analyst/ Analyst will participate in the development of robust and careful empirical analysis of agriculture, land use, energy, and infrastructure development. The ideal candidate for the position is focused, self‑driven, and empirically curious. CPI expects the Analyst to produce high‑quality materials under demanding deadlines, so the ideal candidate must also systematically demonstrate acute attention to detail and a strong capacity to prioritize when simultaneously tackling multiple tasks. The Analyst will also help in drafting policy reports and will interact with policymakers and stakeholders in the private, public, and non‑profit sectors.

In conducting analysis, the Analyst is required to work in close cooperation with a range of partners from the policy, finance, and corporate spheres, as well as with CPI teams throughout the world.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Includes the following and others as assigned:

Data Handling and Analysis : Effectively manage diverse data formats, collect, clean, and process in various formats from diverse sources, constructing and executing procedures for statistical and econometric analyses.

Analytical Output : Generate and format analytical outputs, including tables, graphs, and maps to visually represent research findings.

Content Production : Collaborate closely with the Communications team in the writing and editing of high‑quality CPI products, encompassing technical papers, comprehensive reports, policy briefs, white papers, and presentations.

Engagement and Communication : Engage with policymakers, researchers, and stakeholders from the private and non‑profit sectors throughout the research process. Communicate the implications of research findings effectively.

Research Integrity : Strictly adhere to transparent and reproducible research requirements in the execution of daily tasks.

Other : Be open to (domestic) travel if required to fulfill job responsibilities.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

Essential

  • Commitment to CPI’s mission and values.
  • BA or BS degree required with coursework in finance, economics, and policy.
  • Proven experience with data management and analytics (R or Python).
  • Verbal and written proficiency in Portuguese and English languages.
  • Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines.

Beneficial

  • Master’s degree in economics, Finance, Public Policy, or a related, quantitatively rigorous field strongly preferred.
  • Previous professional experience in a relevant field, ideally with a focus on agriculture, energy, infrastructure and land use.
  • Experience analysing economics of policy choices, and/or energy, infrastructure, adaptation, agriculture/land use finance.

Personal Attributes

  • Independent, analytical mind with a track record of applying sound political and strategic judgment to complex issues.
  • Flexibility, professionalism, enthusiasm for working as part of a team, and an ability to interact with a diverse array of people.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and prioritization skills, and an ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines.
  • Strong Portuguese and English written and verbal communications skills.

Position details

CPI is recruiting for one full‑time position in our Rio de Janeiro office.

CPI has adopted a hybrid working policy whereby staff are able to mix working remotely with two regular days in the Rio de Janeiro office.

CPI offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes 20 days leave + office closure between Christmas and New Year, 5 days study leave, $500 training budget, health insurance.

Salaries are based on experience and market.

To apply

Please submit the following documents:

  • CV/resume no longer than 2 pages;
  • A compelling cover letter outlining why you want to work with CPI and how your skills and experience align with the above requirements.

Only short‑listed applicants will be contacted. Please add to your contact list to ensure delivery of all correspondence from us.

Applications deadline

November 30th 2025

CPI Commitment

Climate Policy Initiative is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion and we are working to embed DEI across every facet of our organisation. We seek to establish a working environment where all board members, staff, volunteers, and contractors feel respected and valued regardless of gender, age, race, ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation or identity, disability, education, or any other bias. We want to create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity are openly valued as critical to the success of our organization and the achievement of our mission and vision.

If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application. We will then work with you to identify the best way to assist you through the recruitment process.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, you’re expected to:

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
  • Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
  • Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;
  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

What are we looking for?

  • Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
  • Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;
  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;
  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;
  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;
  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;
  • Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.
  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar.

Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.

Garantir a preparação, movimentação e fixação segura de cargas, equipamentos e materiais, utilizando técnicas de rigging conforme procedimentos de segurança, normas técnicas e padrões operacionais. O profissional contribui diretamente para a eficiência e integridade das operações offshore.

  • Reportar incidentes, desvios e colaborar em auditorias e investigações;
  • Trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e seguro;
  • Cumprir normas e procedimentos de Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SSMAQ).

Requisitos

  • Ensino Médio completo (desejável formação técnica em Mecânica, Eletromecânica ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência comprovada como Rigger a bordo de embarcações do tipo PLSV;
  • Certificações obrigatórias: CBSP, NR34, NR35 e NR11;
  • Conhecimento em operação de guindastes, rigging e içamento de cargas;
  • Familiaridade com normas e regulamentações offshore;
  • Inglês intermediário e conhecimento em Pacote Office (desejáveis).

Local de trabalho

  • Modalidade: Embarcado;
  • Disponibilidade para embarques e regime offshore.

O que buscamos

  • Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade;
  • O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência;
  • Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento;
  • Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas;
  • Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias;
  • Resultados: foco em entregas com valor.

O que oferecemos

  • Pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado, com salário fixo e benefícios competitivos;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico, para você e sua família, porque cuidar de quem cuida importa;
  • Vale-alimentação;
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, seguro e ético, onde o cuidado com as pessoas e o mar são levados a sério;
  • Oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento profissional, com participação em projetos relevantes, treinamentos e contato com equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Cultura forte e propósito claro, em uma empresa brasileira sólida, que cresce com responsabilidade e inovação;
  • Estabilidade e confiança, em uma organização que atua com excelência e compromisso no setor marítimo e offshore.

Sobre o Grupo Profarma

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição.
